description: Sydney Drinking Water Catchment Boundary is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Water New South Wales (WNSW). Map (non-EPI) of the Sydney Drinking Water Catchment as declared (within the meaning of the Water NSW Act 2014) by s 6. 60 of State Environmental Planning Policy (Biodiversity and Conservation) 2021. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Water New South Wales (WNSW). Its tags are BOUNDARIES-Administrative, Biodiversity and Conservation, Declared Catchment, HUMAN-ENVIRONMENT-Planning, POLLUTION-Water. It offers 4 resource(s) in arcgis rest service, pdf, spatial viewer, zip. The portal shows 2025-10-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
